suggestions.title: Seven of nine /study/ destination pages have no internal link pointing to them
suggestions.detail: Checked every page's outbound links across the whole site: the only internal link to any /study/ page anywhere, including the homepage and the global nav, is a single link to /study/uk. /study/ireland gets three more from blog posts (student-visa-refused-nepal-what-to-do-next, sop-mistakes-that-get-nepali-students-refused, noc-for-abroad-study-nepal). /study/canada, /study/usa, /study/australia, /study/new-zealand, /study/japan, /study/south-korea and /study/finland have zero internal links anywhere in the crawled HTML and are reachable only through the sitemap.
suggestions.why: These are the destination guides the client brief calls the growth engine, the top of the funnel for the much larger student side. A page nothing links to is reached last by search engines and never by a reader browsing the site, which is exactly the orphan problem the playbook warns about. Deciding which existing pages should link to each destination, or whether the global nav should list all nine instead of just the UK, changes visible page content, so it is not mine to fix today.
suggestions.needsYou: A decision on which existing pages should link to the seven orphaned destination pages, or whether the global nav should list all nine destinations instead of only the UK.

suggestions.title: app.officeyak.com carries no noindex signal, unlike a real branch subdomain
suggestions.detail: Re-checked today: happypanda.officeyak.com still correctly returns X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, and app.officeyak.com still returns no X-Robots-Tag header at all, because its slug sits in APEX_LABELS (src/lib/tenancy/host.ts) and is treated as apex rather than a tenant. Its root page still renders the same <title> as the public homepage.
suggestions.why: This is tenancy and middleware code, outside what this routine may touch, and it is a judgement call about whether app.officeyak.com should leave APEX_LABELS, carry its own noindex, or something else, not a one-line mechanical fix.
suggestions.needsYou: A decision on how app.officeyak.com should be excluded from indexing: remove it from APEX_LABELS, or give it its own noindex rule.

suggestions.title: No structured data on /software, /blog, /tools and the nine tool calculators
suggestions.detail: Reconfirmed today, unchanged from prior reports: these 12 pages carry no application/ld+json block at all, while every /study/ page and every individual scholarship page does.
suggestions.why: Adding the right @type (SoftwareApplication or WebApplication for a calculator, CollectionPage for an index) is an editorial call, and getting the type wrong is worse than leaving it out.
suggestions.needsYou: A decision on which @type fits an interactive tool versus an index page.
